name: Army Service Academy
zh: 中国人民解放军陆军勤务学院

evidence.summary: CASI describes the Army Service Academy (陆军勤务学院, which the PLA translates as Army Logistic University), formed in August 2017 from the Logistic Engineering University and the Military Economics College, as a PLA Army academy that trains logistics specialists in fuel, quartermaster, military infrastructure and procurement services, with its main campus in Chongqing.
The academy has reported to PLA Army headquarters since August 2017.

sources.title: The People’s Liberation Army’s 37 Academic Institutions (2020), pp. 100–101
sources.publisher: China Aerospace Studies Institute, US Air Force Air University
